# Clinical Indicator

This folder contains the topic page for clinical indicators, specifically focusing on the supplementary quality metrics used by the Akut Kirurgi Databasen to evaluate 30-day mortality rates following acute surgery. The page details how these indicators stratify patients based on their baseline comorbidity burden, utilizing Charlson Scores to ensure fair and accurate assessments of surgical outcomes relative to underlying health status.

## Pages

- [[clinical-indicator|Clinical Indicator]] — Details supplementary quality metrics for 30-day post-operative mortality, stratified by patient comorbidity burden using Charlson Scores.
